summary: A schedule with catch-up "latest" or "skip" starts only the occurrence its policy selects when the owner's timers run late: an occurrence a later one has superseded is recorded as cancelled instead of starting

replay.detail: No replay change. Existing schedule history is read as before.

schema.detail: No schema change. The skip appends the existing schedule.occurrence-cancelled claim with its existing fields (occurrence, revision, reason).

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or CLI change. Only the schedule's owner runs its timers, so a host's own build decides; a standby takeover already made this check. Catch-up "all" and one-shot schedules are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No new persistent state; an older build reads the cancelled claims as it reads a revision-change cancellation.
